title: Legacy Manager registry compatibility
goal: Read old Manager ownership records without crashes and without granting unsafe termination authority.

tasks.description: Introduce a current registry schema version and an explicit schema-1 legacy DTO.
Detect missing process Boundary before current-record validation.
Convert legacy records to OwnershipUnverified with stable diagnostic legacy-process-boundary-missing.
Never call TerminateOwnedProcessAsync for converted legacy records.
Atomically rewrite converted records in the current schema, or retain an explicit migration-pending state with deterministic next-write behavior.
Add real JSON fixture tests and fake-host termination-count assertions.
